EnumProperty.Name: Language Standard
EnumProperty.Description: Specifies the language standard the source is compiled as. The gnu variants add the GNU extensions to the standard.

StringProperty.Name: Sysroot
StringProperty.Description: Uses the directory as the root for the system headers and libraries, instead of the compiler's own.

StringProperty.Name: Target Architecture
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the processor architecture the code is generated for. The code may not run on older processors.

EnumProperty.Name: Optimization Level
EnumProperty.Description: Specifies how hard the compiler works on the code: more optimization makes a smaller or faster program and a slower build.

BoolProperty.Name: Link-Time Optimization
BoolProperty.Description: Keeps the intermediate representation in the object files, so that the linker can optimize across source files.

BoolProperty.Name: Omit Frame Pointer
BoolProperty.Description: Does not keep the frame pointer in a register for functions that do not need one. Frees a register, makes debugging and profiling harder.

EnumProperty.Name: Debug Information
EnumProperty.Description: Specifies how much debugging information is put into the object files.

StringListProperty.Name: Preprocessor Definitions
StringListProperty.Description: Defines one or more preprocessor macros before the source is read: NAME, or NAME=VALUE.

StringListProperty.Name: Undefine Preprocessor Definitions
StringListProperty.Description: Specifies one or more preprocessor undefines.

StringListProperty.Name: System Include Directories
StringListProperty.Description: Specifies directories searched for headers like the system's: warnings in them are not reported.

StringListProperty.Name: Include Directories
StringListProperty.Description: Specifies one or more directories to add to the include path, where the compiler looks for the headers a source includes.

StringListProperty.Name: Forced Include Files
StringListProperty.Description: Specifies one or more files that are processed as if each started with an #include of it, before the source.

BoolProperty.Name: Run-Time Type Information
BoolProperty.Description: Generates the information that dynamic_cast and typeid need. Turning it off makes the code smaller, and they stop working.

BoolProperty.Name: Exceptions
BoolProperty.Description: Enables C++ exception handling. Without it throw and try cannot be used.

BoolProperty.Name: Position Independent Code
BoolProperty.Description: Generates code that works at any address in memory, as a shared library needs.

BoolProperty.Name: Position Independent Executable
BoolProperty.Description: Generates code for an executable that can be loaded at a random address.

BoolProperty.Name: Use Pthreads
BoolProperty.Description: Defines the macros for POSIX threads when compiling, and links the thread library when linking.

BoolProperty.Name: Hide Inline Functions
BoolProperty.Description: Gives inline member functions hidden visibility, which makes the dynamic symbol table smaller.

EnumProperty.Name: Default Symbol Visibility
EnumProperty.Description: Specifies whether the symbols of a shared library are visible outside it unless marked otherwise.

BoolProperty.Name: All Common Warnings
BoolProperty.Description: Enables the warnings about constructions that are questionable and easy to avoid.

BoolProperty.Name: Extra Warnings
BoolProperty.Description: Enables more warnings that -Wall does not.

BoolProperty.Name: Pedantic
BoolProperty.Description: Issues all the warnings the standard demands, and rejects the extensions that it does not allow.

BoolProperty.Name: Treat Warnings As Errors
BoolProperty.Description: Makes every warning an error: the build fails when there is one.

BoolProperty.Name: Disable All Warnings
BoolProperty.Description: Suppresses all warnings.

BoolProperty.Name: Address Sanitizer
BoolProperty.Description: Instruments the code to find memory errors at run time: overflows, use after free.

BoolProperty.Name: Initialize Automatic Variables
BoolProperty.Description: Initializes local variables that have no initializer to zero, so that they never hold stale data.

StringListProperty.Name: Library Directories
StringListProperty.Description: Specifies one or more directories where the linker looks for libraries.

StringListProperty.Name: Libraries
StringListProperty.Description: Specifies libraries to link with, by name: -lm links libm.

BoolProperty.Name: Build a Shared Library
BoolProperty.Description: Produces a shared library instead of an executable.

BoolProperty.Name: Link Statically
BoolProperty.Description: Links against the static versions of the libraries: the executable does not need them at run time.

BoolProperty.Name: Link as a Position Independent Executable
BoolProperty.Description: Produces an executable that can be loaded at a random address.

BoolProperty.Name: Remove Unused Sections
BoolProperty.Description: Lets the linker drop the functions and data nothing refers to. Works best with function and data sections.

BoolProperty.Name: Strip Symbols
BoolProperty.Description: Removes the symbol table and relocation information from the output.

BoolProperty.Name: Inline Functions
BoolProperty.Description: Considers all functions for inlining, even those not declared inline.

BoolProperty.Name: Never Inline
BoolProperty.Description: Does not expand any functions inline apart from those marked always_inline.

BoolProperty.Name: Unroll Loops
BoolProperty.Description: Unrolls loops whose number of iterations is known when compiling. Makes the code larger and often faster.

BoolProperty.Name: Vectorize Loops
BoolProperty.Description: Performs loop vectorization: the loops use the vector instructions of the processor.

BoolProperty.Name: Fast Math
BoolProperty.Description: Makes floating point calculations faster by breaking the rules of IEEE and ISO: results can differ in the last digits.

BoolProperty.Name: Strict Aliasing
BoolProperty.Description: Assumes that pointers of different types do not point to the same object, as the language demands. Code that breaks this rule can misbehave.

BoolProperty.Name: Global Common Subexpression Elimination
BoolProperty.Description: Performs global common subexpression elimination and constant propagation.

BoolProperty.Name: Peel Loops
BoolProperty.Description: Peels loops: copies the first iterations of a loop out of it, when that is known to help.

BoolProperty.Name: Semantic Interposition
BoolProperty.Description: Lets a function of a shared library be replaced at run time by another with the same name. Turning it off allows more inlining.

BoolProperty.Name: Use PLT for Calls
BoolProperty.Description: Calls external functions through the procedure linkage table. Turning it off calls through the global offset table directly.

BoolProperty.Name: Data In Separate Sections
BoolProperty.Description: Puts each variable in a section of its own, so that the linker can remove the unused ones.

BoolProperty.Name: Functions In Separate Sections
BoolProperty.Description: Puts each function in a section of its own, so that the linker can remove the unused ones.

BoolProperty.Name: Profile Generate
BoolProperty.Description: Instruments the program to write profile data when it runs, for the next build to optimize by.

BoolProperty.Name: Profile Use
BoolProperty.Description: Optimizes with the profile data that an instrumented run has written.

StringProperty.Name: Tune For
StringProperty.Description: Tunes the code for a processor, without using instructions that other processors lack.

StringProperty.Name: CPU
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the processor the code is made for (on the architectures where this is how it is chosen).

BoolProperty.Name: SSE 4.2
BoolProperty.Description: Allows the use of the SSE 4.2 instructions.

BoolProperty.Name: AVX
BoolProperty.Description: Allows the use of the AVX instructions.

BoolProperty.Name: AVX2
BoolProperty.Description: Allows the use of the AVX2 instructions.

BoolProperty.Name: Generate 32-bit Code
BoolProperty.Description: Generates code for a 32-bit environment: int, long and pointers are 32 bits.

BoolProperty.Name: Generate 64-bit Code
BoolProperty.Description: Generates code for a 64-bit environment: int is 32 bits, long and pointers are 64.

BoolProperty.Name: Stack Protector
BoolProperty.Description: Adds a guard value to functions with vulnerable objects such as character arrays, and checks it on return.

BoolProperty.Name: Stack Protector (Strong)
BoolProperty.Description: Like the stack protector, and also guards functions with local arrays or references to local variables.

BoolProperty.Name: Stack Protector (All Functions)
BoolProperty.Description: Guards every function, whether it has vulnerable objects or not.

BoolProperty.Name: Stack Clash Protection
BoolProperty.Description: Probes the stack as it grows, so that a large allocation cannot jump over the guard page.

BoolProperty.Name: Control Flow Protection
BoolProperty.Description: Adds instructions that check where indirect jumps and returns land.

BoolProperty.Name: Asynchronous Unwind Tables
BoolProperty.Description: Generates unwind tables that are exact at every instruction, which debuggers and profilers use.

BoolProperty.Name: Common Symbols
BoolProperty.Description: Puts uninitialized global variables in a common block, so that several definitions are merged. Off: they are an error.

BoolProperty.Name: Signed Overflow Wraps
BoolProperty.Description: Defines signed integer overflow as wrapping around, as two's complement does, instead of undefined.

BoolProperty.Name: Trapping Math
BoolProperty.Description: Assumes that floating point operations can raise exceptions, and does not optimize them away.

BoolProperty.Name: Short wchar_t
BoolProperty.Description: Makes wchar_t two bytes long, whatever the target's default is.

BoolProperty.Name: char Is Signed
BoolProperty.Description: Makes the type char signed (or unsigned), whatever the target's default is.

BoolProperty.Name: Undefined Behavior Sanitizer
BoolProperty.Description: Instruments the code to report undefined behavior when it happens: overflows, bad shifts, null dereferences.

BoolProperty.Name: Thread Sanitizer
BoolProperty.Description: Instruments the code to find data races between threads at run time.

BoolProperty.Name: Leak Sanitizer
BoolProperty.Description: Reports memory that is still allocated, and unreachable, when the program ends.

BoolProperty.Name: Instrument For Coverage
BoolProperty.Description: Instruments the program to record which lines run, for a coverage report.

BoolProperty.Name: Instrument For gprof
BoolProperty.Description: Generates the extra code that gprof needs to write profiling information.

IntProperty.Name: Function Alignment
IntProperty.Description: Aligns the start of functions to the next power of two greater than the number.

IntProperty.Name: Inline Limit
IntProperty.Description: Limits the size of the functions that are considered for inlining, in pseudo-instructions.

BoolProperty.Name: C++ Coroutines
BoolProperty.Description: Enables the C++ coroutines (co_await, co_yield, co_return) in the standards before C++20.

BoolProperty.Name: C++ Modules
BoolProperty.Description: Enables the C++ modules (import, export), in the standards before C++20.

BoolProperty.Name: Permissive
BoolProperty.Description: Downgrades some diagnostics about nonconformant code from errors to warnings.

BoolProperty.Name: Thread-Safe Statics
BoolProperty.Description: Guards the initialization of local static variables, so that several threads can reach it safely.

BoolProperty.Name: Implicit Templates
BoolProperty.Description: Instantiates templates where they are used. Off: only the templates instantiated explicitly are made.

BoolProperty.Name: OpenMP
BoolProperty.Description: Enables the OpenMP directives (#pragma omp), for parallel code.

BoolProperty.Name: Clang Modules
BoolProperty.Description: Enables the Clang module system, which replaces the textual inclusion of headers.

BoolProperty.Name: No Built-in Functions
BoolProperty.Description: Does not recognize the functions of the C library (memcpy, printf) as built in, so it does not optimize their calls.

BoolProperty.Name: Freestanding Environment
BoolProperty.Description: Compiles for an environment where the standard library may not exist and main is not the start, as an operating system kernel.

BoolProperty.Name: No Standard Include Directories
BoolProperty.Description: Does not search the standard system directories for headers: only those named with the include options.

BoolProperty.Name: No Standard C++ Includes
BoolProperty.Description: Does not search the directories of the C++ standard library for headers.

BoolProperty.Name: Trigraphs
BoolProperty.Description: Supports the ISO C trigraphs: sequences of three characters that stand for one.

IntProperty.Name: Template Depth
IntProperty.Description: Sets the maximum depth of template instantiation.

IntProperty.Name: Constexpr Depth
IntProperty.Description: Sets the maximum nested evaluation depth of constexpr functions.

IntProperty.Name: Constexpr Loop Limit
IntProperty.Description: Sets the maximum number of iterations of a loop in a constexpr function.

StringProperty.Name: Input Character Set
StringProperty.Description: Sets the character set of the source files, which is converted to UTF-8 on reading.

StringProperty.Name: Execution Character Set
StringProperty.Description: Sets the character set of narrow string and character constants in the program.

StringProperty.Name: Treat Input As Language
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the language of the input files that follow, whatever their extension says: c, c++, assembler.

StringProperty.Name: ABI Version
StringProperty.Description: Uses the given version of the C++ ABI.

StringProperty.Name: Macro Prefix Map
StringProperty.Description: Replaces a prefix of the file names in __FILE__ with another, as old=new. Makes builds reproducible.

StringProperty.Name: Debug Prefix Map
StringProperty.Description: Replaces a prefix of the file names in the debug information with another, as old=new.

StringProperty.Name: Plugin
StringProperty.Description: Loads a plugin of the compiler from a shared object.

BoolProperty.Name: Shadowed Declarations
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a local variable or member shadows another variable, parameter or member.

BoolProperty.Name: Implicit Conversions
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about implicit conversions that may change a value.

BoolProperty.Name: Sign Conversions
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about implicit conversions that may change the sign of an integer.

BoolProperty.Name: Unused Entities
BoolProperty.Description: Enables all the warnings about unused functions, variables, labels and values.

BoolProperty.Name: Unused Parameters
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a function parameter is not used.

BoolProperty.Name: Unused Variables
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a local or static variable is not used.

BoolProperty.Name: Uninitialized Variables
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a variable is used before it has a value.

BoolProperty.Name: Maybe Uninitialized
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a variable may be used before it has a value, on some path.

BoolProperty.Name: Format Strings
BoolProperty.Description: Checks the calls to printf and scanf: whether the arguments match the format string.

BoolProperty.Name: Format Security
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about calls to the printf family that can be a security problem, as a format string that is not a literal.

BoolProperty.Name: Null Dereference
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when the compiler finds that the program dereferences a null pointer on some path.

BoolProperty.Name: Old-Style Casts
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about casts of the C style in C++ code.

BoolProperty.Name: Hidden Virtual Overloads
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a function declaration hides virtual functions of a base class.

BoolProperty.Name: Non-Virtual Destructors
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a class has virtual functions and an accessible destructor that is not virtual.

BoolProperty.Name: Cast Alignment
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a cast increases the alignment a pointer is required to have.

BoolProperty.Name: Cast Qualifiers
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a cast removes a qualifier, as const, from the type a pointer points to.

BoolProperty.Name: Deprecated Declarations
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about the use of the features that the language has deprecated.

BoolProperty.Name: Use Of Deprecated Declarations
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about the use of functions, variables and types marked as deprecated.

BoolProperty.Name: Float Promotion
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a float is implicitly promoted to double.

BoolProperty.Name: Float Equality
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when floating point values are compared for equality.

BoolProperty.Name: Missing Declarations
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a global function is defined without a previous declaration.

BoolProperty.Name: Redundant Declarations
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when something is declared more than once in the same scope.

BoolProperty.Name: Switch Coverage
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a switch on an enumeration has no case for one of its values and no default.

BoolProperty.Name: Switch Without Every Enum
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a switch on an enumeration has no case for one of its values, even with a default.

BoolProperty.Name: Initializer Order
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when the member initializers of a constructor are not in the order the members are declared.

BoolProperty.Name: Missing Return
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a function that returns a value can end without returning one.

BoolProperty.Name: Signed/Unsigned Comparison
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a comparison between signed and unsigned values can give a wrong result.

BoolProperty.Name: Strict Aliasing Violations
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about code that may break the strict aliasing rules the optimizer relies on.

BoolProperty.Name: Padding
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when padding is added to a structure, to align a member or the whole structure.

BoolProperty.Name: Useless Casts
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when an expression is cast to its own type.

BoolProperty.Name: Logical Operations
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about suspicious uses of logical operators in expressions, as the same operand twice.

BoolProperty.Name: Duplicated Conditions
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about the same condition in an if-else-if chain.

BoolProperty.Name: Misleading Indentation
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when the indentation of the code suggests a block that the braces do not make.

BoolProperty.Name: Pointer Arithmetic
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about anything that depends on the size of a function type or of void.

BoolProperty.Name: Undefined Macros In #if
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when an identifier that is not a macro is evaluated in an #if directive.

BoolProperty.Name: Variable Length Arrays
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a variable length array is used.

BoolProperty.Name: Pessimizing Moves
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a call to std::move prevents the copy from being elided.

BoolProperty.Name: Comments
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a comment starts inside a comment, or a line comment ends with a backslash.

BoolProperty.Name: Unknown Pragmas
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a #pragma is not understood by the compiler.

BoolProperty.Name: Invalid Precompiled Headers
BoolProperty.Description: Warns when a precompiled header is found in the search path but cannot be used.

BoolProperty.Name: Effective C++ Style
BoolProperty.Description: Warns about violations of some of the style guidelines of the book Effective C++.

BoolProperty.Name: Fatal Errors
BoolProperty.Description: Stops the compilation at the first error instead of going on.

StringProperty.Name: Warnings Treated As Errors
StringProperty.Description: Makes the named warning an error: -Werror=format.

IntProperty.Name: Stack Usage Limit
IntProperty.Description: Warns when the stack usage of a function may exceed this many bytes.

IntProperty.Name: Larger Than Limit
IntProperty.Description: Warns when an object is larger than this many bytes.

IntProperty.Name: Frame Larger Than
IntProperty.Description: Warns when the size of a function's stack frame is larger than this many bytes.

StringProperty.Name: Output File
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the name of the file the output is written to.

BoolProperty.Name: Generate Dependencies
BoolProperty.Description: Writes a file with the headers each source depends on, in the format of make, while compiling.

BoolProperty.Name: Dependencies (User Headers Only)
BoolProperty.Description: Like generating dependencies, without the system headers.

BoolProperty.Name: Phony Dependency Targets
BoolProperty.Description: Adds an empty target for each header, so that make does not fail when one is deleted.

StringProperty.Name: Dependency File
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the file the dependencies are written to.

StringProperty.Name: Dependency Target
StringProperty.Description: Changes the name of the target in the dependency rule.

StringProperty.Name: Quoted Dependency Target
StringProperty.Description: Like the dependency target, with the characters special to make quoted.

BoolProperty.Name: Use Pipes Between Stages
BoolProperty.Description: Uses pipes instead of temporary files between the stages of the compilation.

BoolProperty.Name: Verbose
BoolProperty.Description: Prints the commands that are run for the stages of the compilation, and the version of the compiler.

BoolProperty.Name: Keep Intermediate Files
BoolProperty.Description: Keeps the intermediate files (preprocessed source, assembly) instead of deleting them.

BoolProperty.Name: Colored Diagnostics
BoolProperty.Description: Colors the messages of the compiler, even when the output is not a terminal.

BoolProperty.Name: Show Column Numbers
BoolProperty.Description: Prints the column number in the diagnostics, after the line number.

IntProperty.Name: Error Limit
IntProperty.Description: Stops the compilation after this many errors.

BoolProperty.Name: Report Time Per Stage
BoolProperty.Description: Reports the time each stage of the compilation took.

BoolProperty.Name: Report Memory Statistics
BoolProperty.Description: Prints the memory the compiler allocated, at the end of the compilation.

EnumProperty.Name: Debug Format
EnumProperty.Description: Specifies the format of the debugging information.

BoolProperty.Name: Split DWARF
BoolProperty.Description: Puts the debugging information in a separate file, which the linker does not have to read.

BoolProperty.Name: Separate Debug Types
BoolProperty.Description: Puts the debug information of each type in a section of its own, so that duplicates can be merged.

BoolProperty.Name: Compress Debug Sections
BoolProperty.Description: Compresses the debug sections of the output.

BoolProperty.Name: Variable Tracking
BoolProperty.Description: Tracks where the variables are during the program, for better debug information of optimized code.

BoolProperty.Name: Eliminate Unused Debug Types
BoolProperty.Description: Leaves out the debug information of the types that the program does not use.

BoolProperty.Name: Output Macro Definitions Only
BoolProperty.Description: Writes the list of all the macros that are defined at the end of the preprocessing.

BoolProperty.Name: Keep Comments
BoolProperty.Description: Does not remove the comments from the preprocessed output.

BoolProperty.Name: Omit Line Markers
BoolProperty.Description: Does not write the line markers that say where the lines came from, in the preprocessed output.

StringListProperty.Name: Quote Include Directories
StringListProperty.Description: Specifies directories searched only for the headers included with quotes, before the other directories.

StringListProperty.Name: Include Directories After System
StringListProperty.Description: Specifies directories searched after the system directories.

StringListProperty.Name: Macro Files
StringListProperty.Description: Processes a file for the macros it defines only, before the source; its output is discarded.

StringProperty.Name: Include Prefix
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the prefix that -iwithprefix adds to its argument.

StringProperty.Name: Include With Prefix
StringProperty.Description: Appends a directory, made of the include prefix and this, to the second part of the include path.

StringProperty.Name: System Root For Includes
StringProperty.Description: Uses the directory as the root for the system header directories only.

StringProperty.Name: Option Passed To Preprocessor
StringProperty.Description: Passes the option on to the preprocessor, as it is.

BoolProperty.Name: No Default Libraries
BoolProperty.Description: Does not link the standard system libraries, but does use the start files.

BoolProperty.Name: No Start Files
BoolProperty.Description: Does not use the standard system start files when linking.

BoolProperty.Name: No Standard Libraries
BoolProperty.Description: Uses neither the standard start files nor the standard libraries.

BoolProperty.Name: Link libgcc Statically
BoolProperty.Description: Links the support library of the compiler statically, even when the program is linked dynamically.

BoolProperty.Name: Link libstdc++ Statically
BoolProperty.Description: Links the C++ standard library statically, so that the program does not depend on its version.

BoolProperty.Name: Export All Symbols
BoolProperty.Description: Puts all the symbols of the executable in its dynamic symbol table, for the use of plugins and backtraces.

BoolProperty.Name: Relocatable Output
BoolProperty.Description: Produces an object file that can be linked again, instead of a program.

BoolProperty.Name: No PIE
BoolProperty.Description: Does not produce a position independent executable.

BoolProperty.Name: Bind Symbols Locally
BoolProperty.Description: Binds the references to global symbols to the definitions within a shared library, when there is one.

BoolProperty.Name: Link Only Needed Libraries
BoolProperty.Description: Records a library as needed only when the program uses a symbol of it.

BoolProperty.Name: Error On Undefined Symbols In Libraries
BoolProperty.Description: Reports an error for the unresolved symbols in object files when a shared library is built.

BoolProperty.Name: Read-Only Relocations
BoolProperty.Description: Makes the relocated sections read-only once the program has started.

BoolProperty.Name: Resolve Symbols At Startup
BoolProperty.Description: Resolves all the symbols when the program starts, not on the first use.

BoolProperty.Name: Non-Executable Stack
BoolProperty.Description: Marks the output as not needing an executable stack.

BoolProperty.Name: Embed Build ID
BoolProperty.Description: Adds a unique identifier to the output, which debuggers use to find its debug information.

BoolProperty.Name: Strip Debug Information
BoolProperty.Description: Removes the debugging information from the output.

BoolProperty.Name: Map File
BoolProperty.Description: Writes a link map: where each piece of the output came from.

BoolProperty.Name: Merge Identical Code
BoolProperty.Description: Merges functions that have identical code into one (supported by gold and lld).

BoolProperty.Name: Use LLD
BoolProperty.Description: Links with the LLVM linker.

BoolProperty.Name: Use Gold
BoolProperty.Description: Links with the gold linker.

BoolProperty.Name: Use Mold
BoolProperty.Description: Links with the mold linker.

BoolProperty.Name: Use BFD
BoolProperty.Description: Links with the BFD linker.

StringListProperty.Name: Options Passed To Linker
StringListProperty.Description: Passes the option on to the linker, as it is. Several, separated with commas, are passed as several.

StringListProperty.Name: Run-Time Library Path
StringListProperty.Description: Adds a directory to the path where the program looks for shared libraries when it runs.

StringProperty.Name: Shared Object Name
StringProperty.Description: Sets the name that programs record for the shared library when they link with it.

StringProperty.Name: Entry Point
StringProperty.Description: Sets the symbol at which the program starts.

StringProperty.Name: Linker Script
StringProperty.Description: Uses the file as the linker script, which says how the output is laid out.

StringProperty.Name: Specs File
StringProperty.Description: Processes the file after the compiler's own specs, to change what the driver does.

StringListProperty.Name: Libraries By Path
StringListProperty.Description: Links with a library by its file name, as it is: -l:libfoo.a.
